Hi,

Greetings

Hope you are doing great!

I would like to update you on an urgent open position with our esteemed client. Please go through the Job Description. Send me your updated resume and expected rate for the below position.

Note: Client is willing to Provide the Re-location Assistance

Role: Java Developer and DEVOPS (Interview will be On 8th September 2017 and offers will be rolled out quickly)
Duration: Full TIme
Location: Sunnyvale, CA

Qualifications
Basic
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology.

Preferred
• 2+ years of strong object-oriented programming and design experience, including Java
• 2+ years of experience with Selenium Automation
• 2+ years working in an Agile software development environment
• At least 2 years of experience in Automation testing on UI, Mobile and web based applications.
• At least 2 years of experience in automation tools like Selenium, Appium, RAFT, or Squish.
• At least 1 year of experience in SOAP/RESTful API, Service Automation Testing & Groovy scripts.
• At ease with maven, svn and git; expertise with continuous integration systems using Jenkins
• Working knowledge of relational database systems and expert SQL scripting skills
• Working knowledge of UNIX or LINUX
• Work experience in
• Experience with Apple domain.(if needed)
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment
